summary: SNDL Inc. filed a Form 6-K announcing that its second closing under the amended arrangement agreement with 1CM Inc. is not expected to proceed because Ontario regulatory approvals will not be obtained by the May 31, 2026 outside date. The transaction was for 27 Ontario cannabis retail stores at $27.2 million cash, part of a two-stage $32.2 million acquisition. The first closing of five stores in Alberta and Saskatchewan was completed on January 7, 2026 and is unaffected. SNDL will reallocate the capital to its existing $100 million share repurchase program, under which it has already bought back over 5.5 million shares since March 31, 2026. Watch for whether termination conditions trigger any break fees or whether SNDL pursues alternative Ontario retail acquisitions.
